faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Union City?
faq.answer: Union City homeowners typically invest $4,500 to $10,000 for a full window replacement project covering 10–15 windows. This East Bay community's 1960s–1980s housing stock features standard sizing that makes replacement efficient and cost-effective. Single window installation starts at approximately $440.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Union City?
faq.answer: Yes. Union City requires a building permit for window replacements. Our team manages all permit applications with the City of Union City Building Department on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Union City?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Union City commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Union City?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Union City replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Union City?
faq.answer: Most Union City projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
